title: Jannini's signed, authenticated statement given to the host

tellings.quote: He sent it and I've already left it with you signed.

plain: A surgeon named Ahmed Foratu, who says his hospital operated on an alien, says a doctor he calls Dr. Jannini wrote a signed statement about the case and that he has already handed it to Michels during their 2026 interview. "He sent it and I've already left it with you signed," Foratu tells him, offering it as backing from a second doctor for an extraordinary account.
